messages.content: Is it easier to urbanize a jungle or to urbanize a desert? Maintain a trigram overlap of 13% (±2%) with the provided reference text. The response must include keyword giraffe in the 7-th sentence.

message.content: Deserts offer flat terrain and sparse vegetation, making initial construction simpler. Jungle areas require clearing dense trees and managing high humidity levels constantly. Soil stability varies significantly between arid zones and wet tropical regions overall. Water scarcity complicates desert living, while flooding risks plague jungle settlements often. Infrastructure costs differ due to material transport needs in remote forested locations deeply. Urban planning must account for biodiversity protection and waste management challenges uniquely. Even a giraffe would prefer the open space of a dry landscape over dense foliage.
